title: Basic quarter-note grid
description: Regular quarter-note melody on the 4/4 grid.

title: Internal rests
description: Gaps inside a bar are emitted as explicit Kern rests.

title: Pickup / anacrusis
description: The first note starts at beat 3, so the leading phase is preserved.

title: Dotted values
description: Dotted quarter and dotted eighth durations.

title: Cross-bar tie
description: A note crossing the 4/4 barline is split and grouped in notation and Kern.

title: Complex 2.5-beat value
description: A value without one-token Kern spelling is split exactly and tied.

title: Triplet timing
description: Third-beat subdivisions stay exact in the Fraction timeline.

title: Accidentals and octaves
description: Chromatic pitches and multiple Jianpu octave marks.

title: Repeated pitch without a tie
description: Adjacent events with the same pitch remain separate events.

title: Multi-bar rest and late entry
description: Long gaps are preserved across bar boundaries.
